key.name: hidden-indicators
key.summary: Quick settings status icons to hide from the top bar
key.description: Class names of quick-settings SystemIndicators (ServiceIndicator = GSConnect). Their toggles in the quick settings menu stay.

key.name: overflow-items
key.summary: Top-bar buttons tucked behind the arrow
key.description: Panel status-area roles, or "title:NAME" for app tray icons (AppIndicator title). Hidden until the arrow is clicked.

key.name: order
key.summary: Saved left-to-right order of the visible top-bar icons (Super+drag)
key.description: Status-area roles or "title:NAME" for tray icons. Icons not listed keep their place.

key.name: auto-hide-seconds
key.summary: Hide the tucked icons again this many seconds after the arrow opens them (0 = never)
key.description: The timer waits while the pointer is over the arrow or a revealed icon, or one of their menus is open.

key.name: always-show-arrow
key.summary: Show the arrow also when nothing is tucked away
key.description: So there is always somewhere to drop an icon (Super+drag). Off: no arrow while nothing is tucked.
